name: PointOne
description: PointOne is an AI timekeeping and bill-review platform for law firms and other professional services. The connector gives Claude  to the signed-in timekeeper's own PointOne data: their time entries, their firm's clients and matters, the outside-counsel billing guidelines that apply to each matter, the firm's classification code sets, and the compliance findings PointOne has already computed against those guidelines.

_published_faq.name: How do I add PointOne to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add PointOne to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.pointone.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the PointOne MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: PointOne provides these MCP tools: get_compliance_results, get_user_info, list_codes, list_time_entries, search_clients_matters, and search_rules.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to PointOne?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to PointOne in legal on the Manufact MCP catalog include GVRN Company Incorporation MCP, Alizé, Ansvar AI, Casepoint, and CiteLaw.
PointOne requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
PointOne is developed by PointOne Technologies Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
